review_candidates.title: Plumbing Engineer
review_candidates.location: El Tagamoa El Khames, Cairo, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Company Description Solid Core is a multidisciplinary engineering firm specializing in Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP), Architectural, and Structural design and coordination services. The team delivers high-quality Technical Office solutions, including detailed shop drawings, BIM modeling, design support, and coordination across all project phases. Solid Core focuses on precision, efficiency, and compliance with international standards, supporting clients with reliable and well-coordinated designs. The firm combines strong technical expertise with a commitment to excellence, creating a solid foundation for successful, high-performing projects. Role Description The Plumbing Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in El Tagamoa El Khames. The role involves designing and reviewing plumbing systems for building projects, including water supply, drainage, and related building services, in alignment with project requirements and MEP standards. Daily tasks include preparing and checking design calculations, drawings, and technical documentation, coordinating with architectural, structural, and other MEP disciplines, and supporting BIM modeling and shop drawing production. The Plumbing Engineer will participate in design reviews, resolve technical issues, ensure compliance with relevant codes and standards, and assist in value engineering and optimization of plumbing systems. Collaboration with project managers and site teams to address design queries and provide technical support is a core part of the role. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Plumbing and Plumbing Design for building projects. Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Water Supply systems and related Building Services. Candidates should possess experience with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) coordination and standards. Candidates should possess proficiency in using design and drafting tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit or similar BIM software). Candidates should possess a relevant engineering degree (e.g., Mechanical Engineering or Building Services Engineering) and familiarity with international plumbing codes. Candidates should possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams on-site. Candidates should possess good communication skills in English, with the ability to document and present technical information clearly.

review_candidates.title: Senior Odoo implementor
review_candidates.description: Odoo Functional Consultant – Egypt Location: Egypt Employment Type: Full-time Department: Odoo / ERP Consulting We are expanding our Odoo consulting team in Egypt and are looking for an Odoo Functional Consultant to join our implementation and delivery team. The role is client-facing and covers Odoo implementation, Finance, Supply Chain, business-process analysis, testing, training, and go-live support . We are looking for someone who can understand how a business operates, translate business requirements into Odoo solutions, and take ownership of functional delivery. What You’ll DoOdoo Implementation Participate in and deliver end-to-end Odoo implementations. Gather and analyze business requirements. Conduct business-process and gap analysis. Configure Odoo according to business requirements. Prepare and execute testing and UAT. Prepare users and deliver Odoo training. Support data preparation and migration. Prepare and validate opening balances where applicable. Support go-live, hypercare, and post-go-live activities. Perform functional QA and support SLA requirements. Finance & Accounting Depending on your experience and project assignment, you may work on: Chart of Accounts design, setup, and mapping. Journals, taxes, and fiscal positions. AP/AR processes. Multi-currency operations. Banking and reconciliation. Costing and landed-cost workflows. Financial reporting and KPIs. Opening balances. Financial integrations and process automation. Multi-company accounting structures. WIP accounting. Foreign-currency processes. Capital and profit-distribution processes. Financial procedures and controls. Supply Chain You may also work on: Products, SKUs, variants, and units of measure. Product packaging. Purchasing and vendor management. Receipts, deliveries, and inventory operations. Stock locations and warehouse structures. Reordering rules and inventory adjustments. Vendor lead times and purchase agreements. Costing methods and landed costs. Inventory valuation. Routes and logistics workflows. MTO / MTS. Dropshipping. Manufacturing and BOMs. Subcontracting. Traceability and Quality. Multi-warehouse operations. Barcode workflows. Project Delivery Participate in project planning and milestone delivery. Lead or participate in client workshops. Translate business requirements into functional solutions. Prepare UAT scenarios and documentation. Participate in internal and client UAT sessions. Train end users and key users. Support go-live and hypercare. Prepare functional documentation. Coordinate with Project Managers and technical teams. Follow up on assigned tasks, deliverables, and deadlines. Provide ongoing functional support when required. What We’re Looking For Proven experience with Odoo ERP . Experience participating in or managing Odoo implementations. Strong understanding of business processes. Practical experience in Finance/Accounting and/or Supply Chain . Ability to perform requirements gathering and gap analysis. Experience with configuration, testing, UAT, and user training. Understanding of data migration and opening balances. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to communicate with both business users and technical teams. Good written and spoken English . Strong Arabic communication skills. Ability to work in a client-facing consulting environment. Strongly Preferred Experience delivering end-to-end Odoo implementations . Experience with multi-company or multi-warehouse environments. Experience with inventory valuation, landed costs, costing, and foreign currency. Experience with Manufacturing, Quality, Barcode, or advanced Supply Chain workflows. Experience working with Odoo technical teams and understanding functional/technical boundaries. Experience working across different industries and business models. What We Value We are not looking for someone who only knows where Odoo's configuration menus are. We want consultants who can: Understand the business → identify the problem → design the process → configure Odoo → test it → train the users → support the business through go-live. The level of responsibility will depend on your experience and demonstrated capabilities. Apply If you have practical Odoo implementation experience and want to work on real ERP transformation projects across Finance, Supply Chain, and business operations, we would like to hear from you. Please send your CV and include: Years of Odoo experience Odoo versions worked with Number of implementations delivered Odoo modules you have implemented Your role in those implementations Finance vs. Supply Chain experience Industries you have worked with Examples of complex Odoo projects you have delivered

review_candidates.title: performance Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Performance Marketing Manager Location: Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt (Full-time, On-site) Industry: EdTech About the Role We are looking for a data-driven and results-oriented Performance Marketing Manager to lead our paid acquisition efforts. This is a high-impact role responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing our digital marketing strategy to drive student enrollment and achieve aggressive growth targets. You will be the owner of our paid media budget, responsible for maximizing return on ad spend (ROAS), reducing customer acquisition costs (CAC), and building a robust pipeline of qualified leads. Key Responsibilities Strategy & Execution: Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive paid advertising strategies across multiple digital channels, including but not limited to Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, and LinkedIn. Build and execute full-funnel campaigns, focusing on both brand awareness and high-intent conversion stages to drive student enrollment and retention. Effectively manage the advertising budget, strategically allocating spend across platforms and campaigns to ensure maximum efficiency and ROI. Optimization & Analysis: Analyze campaign performance data daily and weekly, translating insights into actionable optimizations. Monitor key metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, and ROAS. Continuously optimize for target KPIs, including Cost Per Lead (CPL), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Lead A/B testing on all campaign elements, including ad copy, creative, audience targeting, and landing pages, to continuously improve performance. Monitor changes in advertising platform algorithms and update strategies accordingly to stay ahead of the curve. Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with the creative and content teams to brief and produce high-performing ad creatives, videos, and landing pages that resonate with our target audience (students, parents, professionals). Prepare and deliver detailed monthly performance reports to management, outlining results, challenges, and strategic recommendations for improvement. Collaborate with the sales team to ensure alignment between marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and sales goals, analyzing the complete customer journey from first click to enrollment. Qualifications & Requirements Experience & Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 3-5 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing or digital advertising, with a proven track record of managing large-scale campaigns. Previous experience in the EdTech, education, or subscription-based services sector is a strong plus. Technical Skills: Platform Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in managing and optimizing campaigns on Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Analytics & Tools: Deep familiarity with analytics and tracking tools, including Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and pixel/API setup for conversion tracking. Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) is advantageous. Data Analysis: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to interpret complex data sets and make data-driven decisions. Core Competencies: Strategic Mindset: Ability to develop high-level marketing strategies and translate them into actionable campaign plans. Testing & Experimentation: A relentless focus on testing and optimization (A/B testing, multivariate testing) to improve performance. Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain performance and strategic recommendations to stakeholders. Leadership: Experience managing or coordinating with a team and external partners is highly desirable.

review_candidates.title: Cost Accounting Senior Officer - Construction Background
review_candidates.description: Company Description SQUARE Engineering Firm (Square S.A.E) is an Egyptian joint-stock company founded in 1992, specializing in contracting and distinguished architectural projects. The firm collaborates with a network of experienced consultants and architects, supported by committed associates and the expertise of its founders. A specialized technical office provides extensive knowledge of local and international practices, helping ensure high-quality project execution. This integrated know-how enables Square to deliver projects that meet strict technical and timing commitments while maintaining strong client relationships. Role Description The Cost Accounting Senior Officer – Construction Background is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. The role is responsible for preparing, analyzing, and monitoring project cost reports, budgets, and forecasts to support effective financial control of construction projects. Daily tasks include reviewing and allocating project expenses, ensuring accurate cost coding, reconciling cost data with financial records, and supporting month-end closing activities. The position involves working closely with project managers, site engineers, and the finance team to verify quantities, validate subcontractor and vendor invoices, and assess cost variances against budgets. The Senior Officer will also support the preparation of management reports, contribute to financial planning for new projects, and recommend cost optimization measures while maintaining compliance with company policies and relevant accounting standards. Qualifications Strong knowledge of finance and cost accounting principles relevant to construction projects. Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements and project cost reports. Proficiency in accounting software and enterprise systems used for project cost control. Solid background in accounting, including general ledger, budgeting, and reconciliation. Advanced analytical skills to interpret financial data, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certification (e.g., CMA, CPA) is an advantage. Previous experience in construction or engineering industries in a similar cost accounting role. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams. Proficiency in MS Excel and other relevant financial analysis tools.
